state_space: Finite typed precision state (lambda,x) plus finite environment record states and finite path-history multiplicities; no continuum state is primitive.
transition_law: A predeclared serial state-extensional correspondence propagates current physical states and path multiplicities; environment interactions generate finite record maps. The current V0 premodel does not yet derive the record generator from apparatus variables.
observation_map: For a two-alternative interference task, eta is the exact fraction of finite environment microstates on which the two record maps agree. Candidate visibility law: V_predicted = eta * V_ordinary, with V_ordinary supplied independently by the ordinary apparatus/environment model.

parameters.name: eta
parameters.prior_allowed_region: rational numbers 0 <= eta <= 1 fixed before comparison for a declared apparatus/environment configuration

symmetries.name: spatial/kinematic symmetry
symmetries.residual_observable: No symmetry claim is made until a concrete record-generation dynamics and geometry layer are supplied; any unavoidable anisotropy must be routed to P016-F1/F8.

predictions.observable: matter-wave fringe visibility relative to an independently calibrated ordinary-quantum/environment baseline
predictions.unavoidable_prediction: For a predeclared eta, V_predicted = eta * V_ordinary. In particular eta = 0 predicts zero interference visibility whenever V_ordinary is nonzero.
predictions.current_constraint: Pedalino et al. (Nature 2026) observe quantum-distinguishing sodium-nanoparticle interference around 172 kDa with representative fringe visibility V = 0.10 +/- 0.01 and report no breakdown related to mass or size alone.
predictions.excluded_parameter_region: The point eta = 0 is incompatible with the reported nonzero quantum-distinguishing interference for that declared setup. No broader eta interval is claimed excluded here because R004 has not yet implemented the experiment-specific likelihood/calibration map.
predictions.falsified_if: For any apparatus/environment configuration whose eta is fixed independently of the interference data, the experimentally allowed visibility interval is disjoint from eta times the independently calibrated ordinary visibility interval.
